Carbon DC sells high-power DC EV charging that runs on a building's existing electrical capacity, using its CarbonCore hardware (battery storage and variable DC output) and CarbonMind software for energy management. Its customers are multi-unit buildings, hotels and commercial real estate property owners and managers who need EV charging without service upgrades. The company states that its charging requires no service upgrades, since it uses the building's existing electrical capacity.

Vulcan Cyber's platform orchestrates and tracks the vulnerability remediation lifecycle from scan to fix by aggregating risk and asset data, prioritizing vulnerabilities using business context, and automating mitigation processes. The platform is offered to IT security teams at businesses of all sizes, and to cyber security teams and asset owners.

Superblocks is a governed enterprise platform that lets business teams generate AI apps and agents on company data, using their preferred coding agents, while IT controls integrations, permissions, code security, and infrastructure. It is sold to enterprises, where business teams build internal apps and IT and Security teams govern them.

CodeSee is a code visualization platform that provides interactive code diagrams, called Maps, which show how a codebase is organized and how its functions and files connect. Its customers are developers and engineering teams, including enterprise teams, who use it for developer onboarding, code reviews, and refactoring of open source projects or legacy codebases.
